key.name: night-light-enabled
key.summary: Night light on
key.description: Warm the screen colours on the schedule below.

key.name: night-light-temperature
key.summary: Night light colour temperature (Kelvin)
key.description: Lower is warmer. 6500 K is the neutral white point.

key.name: night-light-schedule
key.summary: When night light is active

key.name: night-light-from
key.summary: Custom schedule start (HH:MM, local time)

key.name: night-light-to
key.summary: Custom schedule end (HH:MM, local time)

key.name: transition-minutes
key.summary: Length of the gradual change at the start and end of the schedule

key.name: night-light-current
key.summary: Current night light temperature (written by fp6-display-comfort)
key.description: What the shell's colour filter shows now; 6500 = no filter. State, not a setting.

key.name: use-location
key.summary: Use the phone's location for sunset and sunrise
key.description: Asks GeoClue (only while Location is on) at most every few hours; falls back to the fixed coordinates.

key.name: latitude
key.summary: Fixed latitude for sunset/sunrise (degrees north)

key.name: longitude
key.summary: Fixed longitude for sunset/sunrise (degrees east)

key.name: located-latitude
key.summary: Last latitude from GeoClue (rounded to 0.1 degree; state)

key.name: located-longitude
key.summary: Last longitude from GeoClue (rounded to 0.1 degree; state)

key.name: located-time
key.summary: Unix time of the last GeoClue location (0 = none; state)

key.name: status
key.summary: Human-readable schedule status (written by fp6-display-comfort)

key.name: greyscale-active
key.summary: Show the screen in greyscale
key.description: May also be switched by other services (e.g. a bedtime mode).

key.name: dark-theme-mode
key.summary: Dark theme schedule
key.description: off: never switch (the Background & Appearance switch alone); on: always dark; follow-night-light: dark while the night light schedule is active; sunset-sunrise / custom: own schedule.

key.name: dark-theme-from
key.summary: Dark theme custom start (HH:MM)

key.name: dark-theme-to
key.summary: Dark theme custom end (HH:MM)

key.name: dark-theme-shell
key.summary: Also switch the shell (panel, launcher, indicators) between light and dark

key.name: dark-theme-active
key.summary: Dark theme currently applied by the schedule (state)

key.name: interface-scale
key.summary: Interface scale: pixels per grid unit (24 = default)

key.name: font-scale
key.summary: Text size in percent (100 = default)

key.name: bold-text
key.summary: Bold text: heavier default weight for Lomiri apps and the shell (next login)

key.name: session-bold-text
key.summary: Bold text of the running session (state)

key.name: session-interface-scale
key.summary: Interface scale of the running session (state)

key.name: session-font-scale
key.summary: Text size of the running session (state)
